one_sentence_story: By testing five tough visual controls inside individual fMRI brains in 1997, Nancy Kanwisher pinpointed the Fusiform Face Area — a pea-sized patch under the right temporal lobe dedicated to snapping upright eyes, nose, and mouth into one instant holistic face.
so_what_for_you: Appreciate how Effortless social recognition relies on upright holistic configuration — which is why clear upright eye-level camera framing connects instantly on video calls while inverted or shadowy angles break FFA intuition.
